question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) and logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d03d6966c37c60e3e3eab49e85d0159faf02bc205eb393f0b5b955fb5b8a0a1a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) All the elements shift clockwise excluding the center element.

2) Center element and left bottom corner is flipped vertically subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1db99e77056c6b97a5438337edba094404963557398912f0f1f28f286281fb04.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d63047cdb4ecb01a37bbccb11aa90572910d2f9ee8747eab8cfbaa06c3825de8.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
